tool.title: Run a layer's standing re-pin
tool.description: Dispatch a layer's `standing-repin.yml`: move the pins that carry a standing consent to their newest `main`. Started with the standard GitHub CLI; the run is watched with `gh run watch`.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository whose workflow is run. Default: the current one.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The branch to run it on. Default: the default branch.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: The dispatched run; its outcome is read with `gh run watch` or `gh run view`.

selection.when: Running the `standing-repin.yml` workflow on demand instead of waiting for its trigger, or finding which workflow a CI step belongs to.
selection.limits: Needs a token that may dispatch workflows (actions: write) on the repository.
selection.cost: A full CI run on GitHub's runners.

remedies.none: The workflow runs on GitHub; with no host there is nothing to dispatch. The scripts it runs can still be run locally by their own keys.
